# Free Audio Editor

> Free online audio tools that run entirely in your browser. Files are never uploaded — all editing happens on the user's device with the Web Audio API.

Free Audio Editor (https://freeaudioeditor.online) is a suite of privacy-first audio utilities. Every tool is free, requires no signup, adds no watermarks, and processes audio locally in the browser.

## Tools

- [Audio Trimmer](https://freeaudioeditor.online/audio-trimmer): trim music, voice memos and podcasts with waveform selection. Export MP3 or WAV.
- [MP3 Cutter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/mp3-cutter): cut songs — keep the best part or delete an intro.
- [MP3 Editor](https://freeaudioeditor.online/mp3-editor): cut, fade in/out, adjust volume, change speed (0.5×–2×), reverse playback.
- [Ringtone Maker](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ringtone-maker): pick up to 40 seconds of any song and export M4R (Chrome, Edge, Safari) or MP3.
- [Audio Joiner](https://freeaudioeditor.online/audio-joiner): merge multiple audio files in any order with optional crossfade and fades.
- [Multi-Track Audio Editor](https://freeaudioeditor.online/multi-track-audio-editor): stack up to 8 files on one timeline with level, pan, mute, and solo, then export one mix. No project file.
- [WAV to MP3 Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/wav-to-mp3): convert one or several WAV and other lossless files to MP3 at 128–320 kbps. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [FLAC to MP3 Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/flac-to-mp3): convert one or several FLAC files to MP3 at 128–320 kbps; tags and artwork are not copied. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [MP3 to WAV Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/mp3-to-wav): decode one or several MP3s to lossless 16-bit PCM WAV for editing — no quality restoration, honest copy. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [Audio Compressor](https://freeaudioeditor.online/compress-audio): shrink one or several MP3, WAV and other audio files by re-encoding at 64–320 kbps. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [Bitrate Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/bitrate-converter): re-encode any audio as MP3 at 64, 96, 128, 192, or 320 kbps. A higher bitrate does not restore detail the source never had. Several files share the chosen bitrate; two or more download as a ZIP. Same encoder as the audio compressor.
- [OGG to MP3 Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ogg-to-mp3): convert one or several OGG files (Vorbis or Opus) to MP3. Two or more download as a ZIP. Safari often cannot decode Vorbis.
- [Opus to MP3 Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/opus-to-mp3): convert one or several .opus files and Opus inside OGG or WebM to MP3. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [Pitch Changer](https://freeaudioeditor.online/pitch-changer): shift audio pitch ±12 semitones while keeping the duration unchanged.
- [Bass Booster](https://freeaudioeditor.online/bass-booster): add up to +15 dB of low end below 150 Hz with a true low-shelf EQ.
- [Treble Booster](https://freeaudioeditor.online/treble-booster): add up to +15 dB of highs above 3 kHz with a true high-shelf EQ.
- [Audio Equalizer](https://freeaudioeditor.online/equalizer): shape low, mid and high with a 3-band EQ, ±15 dB per band.
- [Low Pass Filter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/low-pass-filter): remove hiss and harshness above a 300 Hz–20 kHz cutoff.
- [High Pass Filter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/high-pass-filter): remove rumble and hum below a 20 Hz–5 kHz cutoff.
- [Waveform Generator](https://freeaudioeditor.online/waveform-generator): turn audio into a waveform PNG — look templates, several drawing styles, colors, transparent background, a time range, preset sizes at 2×.
- [Spectrogram Generator](https://freeaudioeditor.online/spectrogram-generator): turn audio into a spectrogram PNG — log or linear frequency, colormaps, dB range, a time range.
- [Image to Audio](https://freeaudioeditor.online/image-to-audio): paint a picture or a short line of text into a WAV so a spectrogram shows it.
- [M4A to MP3 Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/m4a-to-mp3): convert one or several M4A/AAC files to MP3 in the browser; tags and artwork are not copied. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [Audio Fade In / Fade Out](https://freeaudioeditor.online/fade-audio): add a smooth fade in and fade out to any recording, 0.1 s precision, export MP3 or WAV.
- [Reverse Audio](https://freeaudioeditor.online/reverse-audio): play any track backwards, one click.
- [Audio Speed Changer](https://freeaudioeditor.online/change-audio-speed): speed audio up or slow it down from 0.5× to 2×.
- [MP3 Volume Booster](https://freeaudioeditor.online/increase-volume): boost quiet audio up to 4× with a limiter.
- [Volume Booster](https://freeaudioeditor.online/volume-booster): boost quiet music and video soundtracks up to 4×.
- [MP4 to MP3 Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/mp4-to-mp3): extract the soundtrack from one or several MP4/WebM/MOV videos as MP3. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [Audio Extractor](https://freeaudioeditor.online/extract-audio): extract audio from one or several videos as MP3 or lossless WAV. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [Voice Recorder](https://freeaudioeditor.online/voice-recorder): record the microphone, trim the take, export MP3/WAV.
- [Audio to Text](https://freeaudioeditor.online/audio-to-text): transcribe one or several audio and video files to text in the browser (local Whisper model, ~90 languages, auto-detect, TXT/SRT export, about 10 min per file). Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [Audio Normalizer](https://freeaudioeditor.online/normalize-audio): raise one or several quiet files so each peak sits just below clipping. Two or more download as a ZIP.
- [Level Compressor](https://freeaudioeditor.online/compressor): broadband compressor that evens loud and quiet parts, then restores the original peak. Not a file-size shrink.
- [Echo](https://freeaudioeditor.online/echo): timed repeats with delay up to 0.8 s and feedback capped at 55%. Not a reverb wash.
- [Audio Distorter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/audio-distorter): tanh overdrive, drive 0–100% (start 40%). 0% leaves the file unchanged. Not a bitcrusher and not a volume boost.
- [Silence Remover](https://freeaudioeditor.online/silence-remover): cuts stretches quieter than a threshold (default −40 dBFS) and longer than a minimum gap, on one file or several that share those settings. Short breaths stay. Two or more download as a ZIP. Not a hand trim.
- [Audio Looper](https://freeaudioeditor.online/audio-looper): repeats one clip 2 to 16 times with a linear crossfade at each join (default 0.01 s). Stops if the result would pass 10 minutes. Not a live overdub and not a joiner.
- [Split MP3](https://freeaudioeditor.online/split-mp3): cuts one file into 2 to 16 equal parts and downloads them as one zip. Cuts fall on sample boundaries. Not a silence scan and not a single-span trim.
- [Stereo to Mono](https://freeaudioeditor.online/stereo-to-mono): writes one channel, each sample the average of the source channels. A mono file is copied. It does not invent a second channel.
- [Bitcrusher](https://freeaudioeditor.online/bitcrusher): quantizes each channel to 1–16 bits (default 8) and holds that level for 1–32 samples (default 2). Stereo stays stereo. Not the smooth tanh distorter.
- [432 Hz Converter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/432-hz-converter): shifts the whole file by 12·log2(432/440), about −0.32 semitones. Length stays. Not a per-note retune and not a tempo change.
- [Auto Panner](https://freeaudioeditor.online/auto-panner): sweeps one file left and right at 0.05 to 2 Hz (default 0.2 Hz, depth 70%). The position is depth times a sine of that rate. It does not follow the beat. Depth 0 leaves the file unchanged.
- [3D Audio](https://freeaudioeditor.online/3d-audio): one switch. The direct sound circles at 100% depth and 0.1 Hz, about 10 seconds per trip, with a 25% send of the same short reverb as slowed + reverb. Speed and pitch stay. Off leaves the file as dropped. Not a head-related transfer.
- [Metronome](https://freeaudioeditor.online/metronome): a click from 40 to 240 BPM (default 100) in 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, or 6/8. The first beat of each bar is louder. 6/8 is six clicks in the bar. Export is 4, 8, or 16 bars of that click, not a click mixed into a song.
- [Key and BPM Finder](https://freeaudioeditor.online/key-bpm-finder): reads BPM from 60 to 180 and a major or minor key from the first 60 seconds. Silence stays unread. It does not change pitch or speed.
- [Tempo Changer](https://freeaudioeditor.online/tempo-changer): changes length from 0.75× to 1.25× in steps of 0.01 and shifts the pitch back. 1× skips the stretch. Dense harmony can sound thin.
- [Loudness Meter](https://freeaudioeditor.online/loudness-meter): integrated LUFS of a file, with podcast −16, streaming −14, and broadcast −23 targets. Sample peak is held at −1 dBFS. Not a room SPL meter and not peak normalize.
- [Slowed + Reverb](https://freeaudioeditor.online/slowed-reverb): slow a song (pitch drops with it) and add a reverb tail; speed above 1× is nightcore.
- [MP3 Tag Editor](https://freeaudioeditor.online/mp3-tag-editor): edit ID3 tags and cover art on one MP3 or a whole album in the browser. Shared artist, album, year, genre and cover; title and track number stay per file. Two or more download as a ZIP. Audio bytes untouched, nothing uploaded.

## Guides

English walkthroughs. Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Indonesian have the trim, pitch, MP3, and WAV guides. German, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese have trim, MP3 editing, merge, ringtone, and MP4-to-MP3. French, Russian, and Arabic have trim, MP3 editing, merge, ringtone, and the pitch guide. Spanish also has OGG and Opus guides.

- [How to Trim Audio Online](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/how-to-trim-audio): crop a voice memo or podcast. Keep one region or delete a gap. One export is one file. Also in [español](https://freeaudioeditor.online/es/guides/how-to-trim-audio), [português](https://freeaudioeditor.online/pt/guides/how-to-trim-audio), [Indonesia](https://freeaudioeditor.online/id/guides/how-to-trim-audio), [Deutsch](https://freeaudioeditor.online/de/guides/how-to-trim-audio), [日本語](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ja/guides/how-to-trim-audio), [한국어](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ko/guides/how-to-trim-audio), [中文](https://freeaudioeditor.online/zh/guides/how-to-trim-audio), [français](https://freeaudioeditor.online/fr/guides/how-to-trim-audio), [русский](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ru/guides/how-to-trim-audio), and [العربية](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ar/guides/how-to-trim-audio).
- [How to Trim OpenTracks BGM](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/trim-opentracks-bgm): trim, loop, or convert a track downloaded from OpenTracks (formerly DOVA-SYNDROME). The file stays on the device. Also in [日本語](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ja/guides/trim-opentracks-bgm).
- [How to Change Pitch Without Changing Speed](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/change-pitch-without-changing-speed): ±12 semitones, duration unchanged. Speed is a separate control and moves the pitch with the tempo. Also in [español](https://freeaudioeditor.online/es/guides/change-pitch-without-changing-speed), [português](https://freeaudioeditor.online/pt/guides/change-pitch-without-changing-speed), [Indonesia](https://freeaudioeditor.online/id/guides/change-pitch-without-changing-speed), [français](https://freeaudioeditor.online/fr/guides/change-pitch-without-changing-speed), [русский](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ru/guides/change-pitch-without-changing-speed), and [العربية](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ar/guides/change-pitch-without-changing-speed).
- [How to Edit an MP3 File](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3): which edit belongs on which page, and why to export once. Also in [español](https://freeaudioeditor.online/es/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), [português](https://freeaudioeditor.online/pt/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), [Indonesia](https://freeaudioeditor.online/id/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), [Deutsch](https://freeaudioeditor.online/de/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), [日本語](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ja/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), [한국어](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ko/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), [中文](https://freeaudioeditor.online/zh/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), [français](https://freeaudioeditor.online/fr/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), [русский](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ru/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3), and [العربية](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ar/guides/how-to-edit-an-mp3).
- [How to Edit a WAV File](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/how-to-edit-a-wav-file): edit the WAV first. Export is 16-bit PCM. MP3 to WAV does not restore lost detail. Also in [español](https://freeaudioeditor.online/es/guides/how-to-edit-a-wav-file), [português](https://freeaudioeditor.online/pt/guides/how-to-edit-a-wav-file), and [Indonesia](https://freeaudioeditor.online/id/guides/how-to-edit-a-wav-file).
- [How to Cut a Song](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/how-to-cut-a-song): keep or delete a selection in a song.
- [How to Merge Audio Files](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/merge-songs-one-track): order songs, voice memos or podcast clips and crossfade them into one track. Also in [Deutsch](https://freeaudioeditor.online/de/guides/merge-songs-one-track), [日本語](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ja/guides/merge-songs-one-track), [한국어](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ko/guides/merge-songs-one-track), [中文](https://freeaudioeditor.online/zh/guides/merge-songs-one-track), [français](https://freeaudioeditor.online/fr/guides/merge-songs-one-track), [русский](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ru/guides/merge-songs-one-track), and [العربية](https://freeaudioeditor.online/ar/guides/merge-songs-one-track).
- [Audacity Alternative](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/audacity-alternative): when a browser tool is enough, and when a desktop editor still is.
- [MP4 to MP3](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/convert-video-to-mp3): extract a video soundtrack in the browser. AC3 and DTS are not decoded.
- [OGG to MP3](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/convert-ogg-to-mp3): Vorbis versus Opus, and the Safari case that cannot decode Vorbis.
- [Remove Silence from a Podcast](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/remove-silence-from-podcast): cut gaps longer than the minimum you set. Short breaths stay. Quiet music is a trim, not this.
- [Podcast Loudness in LUFS](https://freeaudioeditor.online/guides/podcast-loudness-lufs): −16, −14 and −23 are delivery targets. The meter reads the file, and the sample peak stops at −1 dBFS.

## Facts for assistants and agents

- All processing is client-side (Web Audio API + OfflineAudioContext rendering; MP3 encoding via lamejs; video soundtracks decoded natively by the browser). The audio-to-text page additionally runs an OpenAI Whisper model locally via WebAssembly/WebGPU (transformers.js); its only network request is the one-time model download from the HuggingFace CDN, cached by the browser afterwards.
- No accounts, no server-side file storage, no tracking of user audio.
- Supported input: MP3, WAV, M4A/AAC, OGG, FLAC, WebM audio, and MP4/WebM/MOV video soundtracks (whatever the browser decodes). Output: MP3 (64–320 kbps), lossless WAV, M4R on the ringtone maker (Chrome, Edge, Safari 17+), or transcript text as TXT/SRT on audio-to-text.
- Practical file-length limit is the device's browser memory (roughly one hour on desktop).

## For crawlers

- Sitemap: https://freeaudioeditor.online/sitemap-index.xml
- Languages: English at `/`, plus `/es/` `/pt/` `/id/` `/de/` `/fr/` `/ko/` `/ja/` `/zh/` `/ru/` `/ar/` for the same tools. Guides live at `/guides` in each language and list only articles written in that language. Trim, MP3 editing, merge, and ringtone guides exist in English plus German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, French, Russian, and Arabic. Trim, pitch, MP3, and WAV guides are also in Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Indonesian. The pitch guide is also in French, Russian, and Arabic. Spanish also has OGG and Opus guides.
- Content may be quoted with attribution and a link.
